Sure. The main options are pretty simple:

• Raw cacao topping: best if you want rich cacao flavor for bowls, porridge, yogurt, baking, or a classic hot cacao. The sample pack lets you try the three flavors: Pur, Velvet Vanilla, and Cinnamon Dream.
• Wild Charge: best if you want a drink with a natural caffeine kick. It blends cacao with guarana, maca, and kola nut, and you mix 2 to 3 teaspoons into about 200 ml of milk, plant milk, or water.
• GOAT Protein: best if your priority is protein. It’s a goat whey protein powder with about 22 g protein per serving, available in Vanilla or Cacao.
• Kokos options: best if you want a lighter drink. Kokos Pulver Pur has no caffeine, while Kokos Booster includes guarana and does contain caffeine.
